author: Bill Hancock
text: Brad and Richard were outstanding—professional, punctual, and incredibly hardworking. Brad clearly explained the installation process and let me know it would take a couple of days due to the challenges of working in my older home's closet furnace and water heater setup. They went above and beyond to ensure everything was installed properly and working perfectly, and even removed my heavy window unit for me. I couldn't be happier with my new HVAC system and will definitely call Barone for any future HVAC needs. Highly recommended!

author: CRO NBK
text: Brad’s prompt response and top notch service is second to none!! His clear communication and expertise reassured me that he knows what he’s doing. His staff communicated what they were doing as well and held themselves with the upmost professionalism. Prices are fair and the follow up is appreciated. Thank you!

author: Jamie Atteberry
text: Brad and his crew did a great job.  Came right out the same day and had my AC up and running in no time. He explained everything to me as to what was wrong and gave me options.  They were experienced and very thorough.  I'll be calling Barone's with any other heat and air needs!

author: Gail Wacker
text: My older HVAC unit died of old age. Barone's Heat&Air llc in Joplin, came to the rescue. Installed a new unit, took care of the old unit in a matter of hours. The only time they left was for lunch break. No running for parts, or tools forgotten. All three men were very knowledgeable and courteous.  Mr Barone explained to me what was happening as they went along, so no surprises. Very happy w the new unit and smooth install.

author: Ash Sahni
text: I have had Brad and his team out a couple times over the years for Duct Cleaning. His team cleans the registers, returns, vacuums out very well, and disinfects. His team is very great about their work but also the clean up. Brad’s communication and feeback is also super helpful for the future. In addition, they were great about working around pets as well. Highly recommend Brad for your needs.

author: Billy Garrigan
text: Highly recommend! Was referred by a friend and he took great care of us! Quickly diagnosed the problem and fixed it. Thank you for getting to us so quickly! Fast, friendly and reasonably priced. Happy to know who to call for future needs!

author: Susan Parish
text:
Always comes same day I call and takes care of my heat pump immediately and completely..
always fair price if any charge at all. The kind of friend to have!

author: Monica Klaurens
text:
Brad and his crew installed a complete unit, removed and disposed of the old unit, and returned the following day to double check everything was working without issues. Getting to the unit in the attic was a challenge, and they were extremely careful with walls, flooring and doorways.

Price and equipment was competitive, but the service was beyond expectations. All three gentlemen were friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. They went above and beyond, including clearing the drain lines to all my units, cleaning up (including vacuuming) all areas, and answering all my questions.

I highly recommend this small business.

Carl Junction, MO

author: Kyle Bateman
text: My wife and I are new to Joplin and were referred. We couldn’t have asked for better service. They were very responsive and informative! Definitely recommend using their services!

author: Mary Hunt
text: Have had my heat pump for 11 years now, and a common part needed replaced for the first time, and they were out at my place same day, so fast. Great customer service, and my house is cool and dry again. Thank you!

author: Jason Damer
text: Brad is hands down the best HVAC professional I've ever worked with. He's always quick to respond and shows up right when you need him. He is incredibly knowledgeable and also takes the time to explain things clearly and make sure you are getting the best possible deal. He goes above and beyond to make sure everything is done right. If your looking for someone reliable, honest, and skilled, Brad is your guy.

author: Amanda Orr
text: Brad showed up and had my ac running in less then an hour. Got the broken part replaced and installed a filter that should have been there all along all at a very reasonable price!

author: Matt Waggoner
text: Brad and his crew at Barone’s Heat and Air have been keeping my HVAC unit running smooth. Service calls are always taken and completed in a timely manner with knowledge and expertise! When my father was diagnosed with an incurable lung disease, that left him sensitive to the air quality he breaths, Barone’s Heat and Air showed up promptly to make sure the unit was operating correctly AND they went above and beyond by doing an entire cleaning of every duct in the house!! They always stay within budget and never hide anything to push costs up and increase the invoice. They’re the only recommendation I’ll make!

author: John House
text: My house heater broke down coming up on the weekend!  Blower motor burned up along with bad condensation problems, and a bad igniter.  Brads team came out and fixed everything.  Runs very smooth and quietly now.  Might not mean much to some, but we were a thousand miles from home, so it did mean a lot to us to be able to come home to a nice warm house!  Very trust worthy folks!  Price was very reasonable!

author: TF2Pooper
text: Brad got our AC working within 5 minutes of showing up during an early spring heat wave. Professional HVAC service, would recommend 100%

author: Debbie
text: I had a situation where my home had a burning smell when I had my heat on and I called Brad and he came out the next day and found that there was absolutely nothing wrong very very polite and courteous company extremely detailed making sure that my home was completely safe in my unit was working perfectly I highly recommend this company they were very reasonable and customer service was extremely excellent thank you for everything that you do to keep people safe and I'm extremely grateful that you made sure I was safe and all was well many blessings to you and your company

author: Russ Constable
text:
Brad was able to get us into his schedule very quickly. Turns out we had a cracked manifold, Brad took the care to look at everything and found  another item that wasn’t done correctly by a previous company.

Overall, he explained everything to us along the way. We felt like he had our best interests in mind rather than quickly getting things done and running.

author: jake .brummer
text: Amazing to work with and upfront and honest guys! Would recommend to anyone in the area wanting the job done right. There work always exceeds our expectations!

author: Freight Train
text: Brad and his team showed up and got my furnace fixed in no time. Outstanding customer service!  He took the time to explain the situation, and even gave me some pointers to watch for in the future. Great all around!  I will definitely call Barone’s the next time I’m in need of HVAC assistance.

author: Alicia Casebeer
text: My family and I been using Barone’s Heat & Air for over 10 years in the Carthage area. He is dependable and has provided great service through out the years with repairs/maintenance and installing a new unit. Highly recommend!!!

author: Laila Douglas
text: Even faster and cheaper than quoted, very friendly. 100% recommend- will be a returning customer! ☺️

author: Aren Stark
text: The instillation was a quick easy process that they helped me through if I had any questions, they were very easy to communicate with and easy to work with

author: Elijah Paden
text: Called before 8am this morning and they were here in under 2 hours. Fix only took 30 minutes, quick and efficient work from these guys.

author: Gretchen Goddard
text: I can’t recommend Barone’s Heat and Air enough. Brad repaired one AC and replaced another during the hottest days in July. He was prompt with next day service. He even put in a window unit for the night until the unit was installed the next day. Dependable, honest and efficient. Truly went above and beyond.

author: Rene’ Harbin
text: Brad and his crew have taken care of both my home and business for over 15 years — and they’ve never once failed to show up and deliver top-notch work. Consistent, dependable, and always exceptional!

author: Christian Hutchinson
text:
Excellent Service and Reliable Team!

I had a fantastic experience with Brone's Heating & Air! My AC stopped working during a heatwave, and they were able to send someone out the same day. The owner was professional, friendly, and clearly knew what he was doing. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything in simple terms, and had it fixed within an hour.

Pricing was fair, and they didn’t try to upsell me on anything I didn’t need. It’s rare to find a company that’s this honest and responsive. I’ll definitely be using them again for all my heating and cooling needs—and recommending them to friends and family!

author: Sarah Heholt
text: Barone's Heat & Air is a great company. I was able to get a next day appointment for some help with my AC unit. The work was fantastic, helpful information was provided, and they were upfront with pricing. I would really recommend this company!!

author: Gary Selby
text: Brad was great. Came out the same day during extreme heat wave. Communicated and diagnosed the issue. Very personable, professional, and will be my guy the next time I need any heat or air conditioning issues! Thanks again!!! Gary

author: Don Olsen
text: Brad actually answered the phone (no voicemail or phone-tag) when I called about our A/C failing and he managed to fit us into his schedule on the same day. He resolved the issue in less than 20 minutes and was on his way to his next job. Thanks for the great work and making sure we didn't sleep another night in the heat.

author: Katie Gronberg
text: Brad has been keeping my HVAC needs met for years now! He really cares about the people he services on top of a job well done! He is easy to work with and is someone my family can always count on to keep warm in the winters and cool in the summers!

author: chris hedgcorth
text: Saved me over $1200 on a new unit install and even fixed our bathtub when they were done. Very friendly people that I won't hesitate to call for future work. Highly recommended

author: Stephen Kauffman
text: Brad and his team are the best. I have used them for years and recommend them to anyone in need of HVAC repair. The guys are super knowledgeable and take care of you fast. Give Barone's a call the next time you are in need of HVAC repairs, seasonal prep of in need of a new unit. You will not be disappointed

author: Debby Lamoure
text: Brad at Barone's Heat and Air worked my A/C issue into his already full repair schedule. The compressor fan motor was not turning and was loudly humming. He assessed the issue and quickly had the fan working. He would not charge me for the service call. I highly recommend his outstanding service and will keep his company for any future A/C or Heating issues I may have. I am a Realtor and I am definitely recommending Barone's Heat & Air to my Real Estate clients.

author: Janet Tonnar
text: First time contacting Barones’s when our AC went out on a Thursday evening and Brad squeezed us in this morning.  Got us up and running in no time.  Fast, friendly, and affordable!

author: L E R I U M
text: Man these guys are just awesome. Very friendly service!

author: Roger Lieb
text: Brad and his team make their work personal and take care of you as if you had been friends for years.  The quality is excellent and they make sure things are working properly even months later.  Very professional and priced well.

author: julia ansari
text: These guys are amazing. I called them last minute and Greg Adams Came to fix my AC system. They are very fair with pricing. I am more than satisfied with ACCI. Amazing team and would recommend them to anyone.

author: McVay Pest Control
text: These guys are amazing. They came out the very first day we called and said our air conditioning was not working. Even had me try a few things over the phone prior to coming out. They were able to find the issue and were able to figure out the problem immediately.  They were upfront and honest about all their work. It’s not easy to find honest people these days. However,  these guys were very honest and very professional work. Highly recommend!

author: VolVet03
text: Highly recommend Barone HVAC. Our  home had a complicated older HVAC system with obsolete components that no longer translate to today’s equipment.  Brad came up with the best possible solution for our difficult situation.  Lots of other companies were trying to take shortcuts and still charge us top dollar but Brad shot it to us straight from the beginning and did the job for a price we could afford.  Communication was excellent before and during the project,  he patiently answered all my questions about how this was going to work since we had to make some major changes to the system. For those wondering Barone HVAC is a Goodman dealer and Goodman is known for quality equipment with excellent warranties.

author: Russell Webb
text: We trust our comfort to Brad and team. Quality work.

author: Nathan Price
text: My HVAC unit went out 5 days before a big cold snap. Brad and his crew came and looked at it the day after it went out, determined it needed to be replaced and was there to replace it just a few days after that in the freezing cold. They were great to work with and my house is nice and warm again!

author: Ray Martinez
text: I wouldn’t trust my heat and air to anyone else. These guys came in and worked around a cobbled together furnace to get me cool air for the summer. I can’t say enough about them, they’re the best. They went above and beyond what I could even hope to expect and I just really appreciate it. If you live anywhere around the Joplin area, call them first. Honest, reliable, knowledgeable.

author: Judy L.
text: Brad and his guys were very courteous, arrived when they said they would be here, were knowledgeable, answered all our questions and fixed our problem at what we considered a very reasonable price. Glad we found them and will use them for our future HVAC needs.

author: Jessica Mc
text: Brad and his team are the most courteous and professional HVAC service we have found in the area. They freely offered details about our unit that were not explained by the company who installed it. We look forward to supporting this local business!

author: Lynda Williams
text: Barone heating and air has taken care of HVAC systems for several of our rental properties as well as personal residences for more than 14 years. Whether it’s installing a new system or servicing an existing one, he and his team are prompt, professional and knowledgeable. We wouldn’t consider using any other company. They are the best.

author: Hurtzallot Gregory
text: I’m dying with CHF,.Brad took care of me, he’ll be remembered for this forever by a higher authority. I can now breathe in my COOL A/C home.Brad and RJ are truest of professionals. The Mt Rushmore of hvac installers and repair men on planet earth. I have never been treated with such respect these men, they will not leave unless you’re 100% satisfied. UFB. Why waste a single cent elsewhere? I’m still in shock at the professionalism I just witnessed. Thank you! See you soon! God Bless you’re the best 6 stars!

author: Jim
text: Just our luck our heat went out on one of the coldest days so far so I emailed Barones and within 15 minutes I had a reply asking the problem. I figure it would be awhile before I could get someone to look at it but Brad and his crew were at my house within and an hour. He said my unit was in bad shape . He got it running again but he said he didn’t know how long it would last and he was right an hour later it was down again . So I got back ahold of him and he went over everything with me so we decided we needed to replace the unit. It would take a day to get it shipped to him so he brought us two heaters to get us through. So him and his crew came over on a Saturday morning their day off! which was two days after we lost heat and installed the new unit . Within 45 minutes our house was warm again! I can’t recommend Brad and his team enough. Very professional and super friendly. Thank you Brad and you team!

author: Jennifer Dresslaer
text: Professional crew.  Provided prompt and thorough communication before, during, and after completion of the job!

author: Doug McDonald
text: Outstanding service!  Always shows up and does outstanding work!  Best in the business. I have used Barone’s Hear and Air for years and always recommend him!

author: Dwight Brennfoerder
text: A couple of years ago we had Brad and his crew update our aging A/C system.  The result was a great experience and the new system works very well.  This winter we needed to replace a failed humidifier.  Brad and crew returned and installed a fantastic high-output steam system.    Dry winter weather won't be accompanied by shocking surprises in our old house any more.  Thanks Brad.  You guys are quick, efficient and economical.

author: Shelby Roberts
text: They were very polite and kind! I appreciated how fast they came to fix our air conditioner. It was summer so they are automatically our heros :)

author: Shannon Emery
text: Always does fantastic work and gets here very quickly! Would highly recommend

author: walkingchemicalreaction
text: We woke up to no heat in the middle of winter and Barones arrived quickly for our last minute service call. Barones repair men were polite and knowledgeable. They were able to repair our issue in under two hours and didn't ask for an arm and leg to do so. We are so grateful to have an honest repair man in this area.

author: Mary Elliott
text: Brad has been our heating and air guy for years- he is great at what he does and is always fast about getting to our house when we need him. He provides a quality service to our community- my family recommends him 100%! Brad is a good guy, great service and reasonable rates!

author: Cheri
text: Called Friday morning air not working right, they came right out. Decided I needed bigger unit because of addition. Gave me an estimate I agreed to it, even though I thought it was a little high but I just wanted it to be done. And they seemed professional and knowledgeable. Set up following Monday to install. They show up Monday morning with unit and go around back, knock on my door 10 mins later. Owner tells me he should have checked under house because unit isn’t going to work. Quote goes from agreed price to 4-6000$ higher he's not really sure yet. Imagine my surprise!!! Of course how can you trust someone especially the owner after that? Called 4 other businesses for estimates they all arrived throughout the day. What do you know EXACT 5 ton unit that will more than do the job and instillation ‘with boys not afraid to get under the house’ at a much more believable price. I relearned a valuable lesson.

author: Jessica Wilson
text: I called Barones on short notice to check out a couple issues with our AC unit and was surprised at how quick they were able to come out.  They serviced the unit, cleaned it, diagnosed some issues and had the part we needed to replace the very next morning which he came by and replaced as he promised.  The cost was reasonable and he seemed very knowledgeable, even tho we had a custom unit.  Proactive and professional.  Will definitely use Barones for all our heating & cooling needs in the future!

author: Old Friend
text: Great company to have your work done through! Brad works with home warrenty companies and does the work the right way the first time. Honest and fair priced. Will always return your messages and is prompt and on time. If you don't try Barone you're missing out.!

author: Kerstin Tuggle
text: Brad & his people are very professional, courteous & reliable. Brad does yearly maintenance for my A/C & heating. We had a fire at our home & they did our heat/AC & electrical panel. 5🤩’s Good work & good people! …

author: Jadeth James
text: Barone's was great for us! They were always on time or early for appointments. They were very easy to communicate with and were open to using calls (actually answered me!), texts, and emails. They were willing to do anything I asked them to and investigated my very mysterious crawl space problem.

author: James Watson
text:
This is a great local company. They were quick to respond. This is an honest company. They saved us money and never tried to “upsell”. Professional and clean. Courteous and polite. I will use Barones for any future HVAC needs. A+ company!

Watsons of Neosho
